description: This file defines the StreamLogger class in PHP, which implements logging functionality by writing messages to a specified PHP stream resource, such as stderr.

classes.name: StreamLogger
classes.description: A logger class that writes log messages to a PHP stream resource, supporting warn and debug methods, with optional automatic stream closure upon object destruction.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a stream resource and an optional flag to close the stream on object destruction.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Destructor that closes the stream if the closeOnDestruct flag is true.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Logs a warning message to the stream; can include a deprecation flag, which prepends 'DEPRECATION' to the message.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Logs a debug message to the stream.
